title: Release job cannot push to protected main: choose a release path
description:
The Actions release job fails with GH006 pushing to protected main, and GitHub does not allow the Actions app as a bypass actor here. v0.44.0 was released by running semantic-release locally as the owner. Options: owner PAT or GitHub App token in the release workflow with a repository ruleset; or document the manual local release: npx semantic-release --no-ci from a fresh clone with the owner's admin gh token.

Feature: Releases from main
  Scenario: A release is cut
    Given main is protected
    When a release is run by the chosen path
    Then the tag, changelog commit and release are published
right_now_summary: The team must choose between automated App-token releases and documented owner-run local releases.
